info.name: Biodiversity System - Sprint 1
info.description:
Postman tests for the biodiversity backend.

Before running:
1. Run `npm run dev` in the backend folder (with the team's `.env`).
2. Collection Variables tab: set adminEmail / adminPassword to the team's Admin login (ask a teammate).

Note: each run creates test users (...@test.com) and plants in the shared database.

Run the folders in order (or the whole collection with Run). Tokens, plant IDs and QR codes are saved automatically and reused by later requests.

Photo upload: if the upload request has no file, open it, go to Body and choose any image (e.g. postman/sample-leaf.png in the backend folder).
